events.s: ⏰ Reminder: Lock your phone time zone
events.d:
An issue with the cellular towers in Big Bend area may cause them intermittently change your phone to the wrong time zone. To avoid being late to your race, it is best to manually set your time zone. Instructions for: iPhone | Android. You can also cross-check your time.

The race is Central Time (Chicago).

Please read https://trailroots.com/regulations.

100K must purchase https://www.t-mobile.com/coverage/satellite-phone-service
